subject: general
question:
After interchanging which two signs, the value of the given equation will be '11'?

32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : + and -

Given equation is : 32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 32 - 3 + 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

⇒ 32 - 3 + __**12 ÷ 18**__ × 9 = 11

⇒ 32 - 3 + __**0.66 × 9**__ = 11

⇒ __**32**__ - 3 __**+ 6**__ = 11

⇒ __**38 - 3**__ = 11

⇒ 35 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : × and -

Given equation is : 32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 32 + 3 × 12 ÷ 18 - 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + 3 × __**12 ÷ 18**__ - 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + __**3 × 0.66**__ - 9 = 11

⇒ __**32 + 2**__ - 9 = 11

⇒ __**34 - 9**__ = 11

⇒ 25 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : ÷ and -

Given equation is : 32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 32 + 3 ÷ 12 - 18 × 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + __**3 ÷ 12**__ - 18 × 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + 0.25 - __**18 × 9**__ = 11

⇒ __**32 + 0.25**__ - 162 = 11

⇒ 32.25 - 162 = 11

⇒ -129.75 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : ÷ and × 

Given equation is : 32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 32 + 3 - 12 × 18 ÷ 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + 3 - 12 × __**18 ÷ 9**__ = 11

⇒ 32 + 3 - __**12 × 2**__ = 11

⇒ __**32 + 3**__ - 24 = 11

⇒ __**35 - 24**__ = 11

⇒ **11 = 11**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and ×".**
